product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic provides enterprise digital- and media-asset management and content orchestration for global brands, archives, and government agencies.

pricing_page.notes: The site navigation has no pricing link; Orange Logic states its pricing is quote-based and not published.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is a DAM thought-leadership and product-oriented blog; the technical architecture article identified is by Orange Logic’s Head of Content, not an engineer.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal provides API documentation and multiple reference sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists Applied AI Product Engineer.

model_provider.value: NVIDIA Nemotron models are available in Agent Studio; the platform also describes its AI model support as model-flexible.

last_funding.notes: The latest round is listed as private equity; the amount was undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was in May 2023, before the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current open-positions list does not include an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive role.
